_sca_scope: mapped: only SCA checks listed under a requirement's sca_checks become findings (paper: results are matched to a small, documented set of requirements). The other CIS checks stay visible as raw Wazuh results (endpoint pass rate, single report) but are not prioritized. Use "all" to track every failed check.
_about: Synthetic requirement catalogue for the isolated lab (CIS-based titles; no company configuration). Each finding stores the catalogue version it was created with. A check counts for a requirement only through "sca_checks" (exact SCA policy name + check id).
_cis_candidates: CIS check IDs were confirmed on 2026-10-25 in the VMware lab (Wazuh 4.14.9, agent WS01, Windows 11 Pro): same IDs and titles as wazuh-src ruleset/sca/windows/cis_win11_enterprise.yml. Re-check them if Wazuh or the CIS policy version changes.

requirements.title: Ensure 'Minimum password length' is set to '14 or more character(s)'
requirements.remediation: Set Computer Configuration > Windows Settings > Security Settings > Account Policies > Password Policy > Minimum password length to 14 or more in the Default Domain Policy, then run gpupdate and re-assess.

requirements.title: Ensure the operating system drive is encrypted with BitLocker protection on
requirements.remediation: Turn on or resume BitLocker for the system drive (recovery key kept in Active Directory, never in this app), then confirm 'manage-bde -status' shows Protection On and re-assess.

requirements.title: Ensure Microsoft Defender real-time protection is enabled
requirements.remediation: Turn real-time protection back on (Windows Security > Virus & threat protection, or the Defender GPO), then re-assess.

requirements.title: Ensure Microsoft Defender antivirus signatures are no more than 7 days old
requirements.remediation: Update Defender signatures (Update-MpSignature) from the lab's local update source and check why automatic updates stopped, then re-assess.

sca_checks.policy: Capstone Windows supplementary checks v1.0

requirements.title: Ensure Secure Boot is enabled
requirements.remediation: Enable Secure Boot in the UEFI firmware settings (check the disk is GPT and the BitLocker recovery key is stored in Active Directory first), then re-assess.

sca_checks.policy: Capstone Windows supplementary checks v1.0

requirements.title: OS drive reports BitLocker protection On and is 100% fully encrypted (PowerShell collector)
requirements.remediation: Resume or turn on BitLocker for the system drive (Resume-BitLocker -MountPoint C:), wait for encryption to reach 100%, then let the collector report again.

requirements.title: OS drive uses XTS-AES 256-bit encryption (LAB-WS-BitLocker GPO)
requirements.remediation: The encryption method can only be chosen when encryption starts: decrypt, confirm the LAB-WS-BitLocker GPO sets XTS-AES 256, and encrypt again (lab test laptop only).

requirements.title: Audit policy must not be changed outside the Group Policy baseline (event 4719)
requirements.remediation: Find who changed the audit policy, restore it with gpupdate /force, and confirm with the next SCA scan.

requirements.title: The Security event log must not be cleared (event 1102)
requirements.remediation: Record who cleared the log and why, restrict the 'Manage auditing and security log' right to administrators, and keep logs centrally in Wazuh.

requirements.title: New local user accounts must be approved (event 4720)
requirements.remediation: Confirm the new account was approved; disable or delete it if not.

requirements.title: Least privilege: additions to security-enabled local groups must be approved (event 4732)
requirements.remediation: Confirm the group change was approved; remove the member from the group if not.

requirements.title: Repeated failed sign-ins must be investigated (event 4625, 5 or more in the lookback window)
requirements.remediation: Check which account and source caused the failures and confirm the account lockout policy is applied.

requirements.title: Files in the protected synthetic client-records folder must not change without approval
requirements.remediation: Confirm whether the change was approved. If not, restore the file from the lab backup; the next FIM check records the restore.

requirements.title: Selected startup registry keys must not change without approval
requirements.remediation: Confirm whether the startup entry is approved. If not, remove it; the next FIM check records the change.

requirements.title: Only approved software may be installed
requirements.remediation: Uninstall the program or add it to config/approved_software.json after approval; the next inventory scan confirms it.

requirements.title: Only approved ports may be listening
requirements.remediation: Stop or block the service that opened the port (for example disable Remote Desktop), or approve the port in config/approved_ports.json; the next inventory scan confirms it.
